info.name: CampusConnect API
info.description: CCC181 Group 10 IT-3A. Seven required requests. Run in order; login saves a runtime token and the final request clears it. No saved real tokens. Use localhost:3000, with the API running.

exec: pm.test('Health returns 200 and exact JSON', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'ok' }); });

pm.test('Demo login returns token and exact public user', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(data.user).to.eql({ id: 1, name: 'Demo Student', email: 'student@campusconnect.test' }); pm.expect(Object.keys(data).sort()).to.eql(['token', 'user']); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', data.token); if (pm.visualizer) pm.visualizer.set('
{{body}}
', { body: JSON.stringify({ ...data, token: '' }, null, 2) }); });
pm.test('Wrong password returns 401, never a token', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ error: 'Invalid email or password.' }); });
pm.test('Unknown email returns the same 401 message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ error: 'Invalid email or password.' }); });
pm.test('Empty body returns 400', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ error: 'Email and password are required.' }); });
pm.test('Missing token returns 401', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ error: 'Not logged in.' }); });

pm.test('Bearer token returns exact public user', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ id: 1, name: 'Demo Student', email: 'student@campusconnect.test' }); });
